design.null_primary: each firm keeps its own number of active months and draws them with probability proportional to the TRACK's own monthly event volume, so firm activity and the track's growth/seasonality are both preserved; only the cross-firm timing pattern is free
design.null_secondary: same, but weighted by LANE-wide monthly volume only — reported to show how much of an apparent co-movement is track growth rather than synchronisation
design.panel: binary presence per (entity, track) month, 119 complete months
design.statistic: sum over months of C(active firms, 2) within a track
